notes.title: New update: Cerulean Getaway
notes.content:
The Cerulean Getaway was set at the Heliora Sea. While everyone was busy packing, Fenny had just returned from the R&D Department, where she'd gone to update the latest figure measurements for the new exosuits being developed for her and Siris before fabrication. The Adjutant measured and confirmed that Fenny's figure was flawless, yet she felt a twinge of disappointment at her slow workout progress. He reminded that repeated training could lead to a "plateau," and it struck Fenny —  just like their love, sweet yet in need of fresh sparks. Determined to add some excitement, Fenny began plotting a surprise for the Adjutant during the getaway.

1. "Cerulean Getaway" Limited-Time Events Launched

Eligibility: Adjutants who complete Main Story Chapter 1 Progress 6 or Chapter 14 Pt. 2 Hearts in Harmony - United.

Notice: Due to adjustments in the game chapters, Main Story Chapter 14 Pt. 2 will be unlocked ahead of schedule after the 9/25 (UTC+8) maintenance. Adjutants who meet any of the required clearance conditions will also gain access to the limited-time event "Cerulean Getaway."

✧ \[Cerulean Getaway] Event Story

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: During the event, Adjutants who meet the above requirements can experience the Cerulean Getaway event story.

✧ \[Ocean Mall] Event Shop

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: Consume Heliora Badge or Amber Dice to exchange for rewards including Manifestation Echo Covenant, event souvenir "Cerulean Divers" in the Base, the Orange-tier weapon part "Crisis Cutter - Scope," the Purple-tier submachine gun "Honeycomb," three Sprout Squad logistics officers, Quantum Cell, and Carbon Atomic Plate.

The Orange-tier weapon part "Dorsal Crest - Support Module," Purple-tier pistol "Ancient Nautilus" and sniper rifle "Gearlock," and Libra and Nebula Squad logistics officers will be available for exchange in the event shop from 10/16 10:00 to 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8).

Note: Heliora Badge and Amber Dice can be obtained from event gameplay and tasks. After selecting limited-time oriented-echo operatives, exchanges for their signature event Purple-tier weapons and Logistics will be added to Event Shop.

✧ \[Vacation Plan] Event Tasks

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: Complete event tasks to obtain rewards, including the event badges, event avatar, DigiCash, Heliora Badge, and Amber Dice.

✧ \[Bizarre Expedition] Combat Stages

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: Clear combat stages to quickly obtain Heliora Badge.

✧ \[Resurgent Journey] Main Story Prologue

Event Period: 9/25 (UTC+8, After maintenance) - Permanent

Details: A new prologue chapter of the Main Story is now available, featuring fresh stages and story content. Adjutants, get ready to dive in!

✧ \[Frosty Toss-Up] Fun Gameplay

Event Period: 9/25 (UTC+8, After maintenance) - Permanent

Details: The Base's Breezeheart Bay adds an all-new interactive game. Fill the girls' dessert orders by tossing the frosty ingredients into their cups! Get messy making sweet treats together~ Join the gameplay to earn special furniture in Breezeheart Bay.

✧ \[Anchors Aweigh] Co-Op Gameplay

Event Period: 10/20 04:00 - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: New co-op gameplay! Command your operatives aboard a warship as you sail through Seabreeze Cove, Reefbreak Sound, and Galestorm Abyss. Face shifting weather and natural disasters that damage your ship's facilities, and wield heavy cannons and other devices to repel incoming enemies and keep your vessel steady on course.

Anchors Aweigh features 3 difficulty levels, Normal, Hard, and Challenge, with different opening times. Please check the in-game event page for the exact schedule when it's released. Adjutants can take on the challenge solo or team up in co-op. Join the gameplay to earn rewards including exclusive badge, exclusive namecard, DigiCash, Heliora Badge, and Amber Dice.

✧ \[Dreamboard Harbor] Fun Gameplay

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: A simulation management system developed by the Investment Department of Yggdrasil. Strategically allocate resources, roll the dice, plan your development, and outsmart your opponents — bankrupt them or hit key objectives to claim victory!

Dreamboard Harbor has 3 modes: Starter Stages, Tactical Challenges, and Virtual Match. In the Starter Stages and Tactical Challenges, you face off against different girls in 1v1 battles. In the Virtual Match, you can invite friends or be randomly matched for 1v1 online matches. Join the gameplay to earn rewards including exclusive badge, DigiCash, Amber Dice, Heliora Badge, and Opal Vouchers.

✧ \[Let's Optimize, Heimdall!] Fun Gameplay

Event Period: 9/28 04:00 - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: The fun online party event returns with an all-new mode: Let's Optimize, Heimdall! Adjutants can choose to play the original mode in Classic or try the new co-op mode in Assimilation.

In Let's Optimize, Heimdall!, three random players will start as H.A.M.M.s, while the rest take on the role of H.E.R.O.s. The H.A.M.M. Legion wins by assimilating all H.E.R.O.s into Mini H.A.M.M.s, while H.E.R.O.s must survive until the end to claim victory.

✧ \[Starward Defense] Challenge Gameplay

Event Period: 10/13 04:00 - 11/2 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: All-new upgraded gameplay! The new Starward Defense feature, Assist Operative, is now on duty! They will assist you as combat support in stages. And the new Turret Specs feature allows Adjutants to view turret skills and unlock more powerful ones.

During the event, guard the planet to unlock units and build your strength. Completing challenge tasks will unlock powerful skills for your units! Challenge Unyielding Defense to earn generous rewards and unlock powerful unit skills. The modes are divided into phases with different opening times. Please check the in-game event page for the exact schedule when it's released.

In Galactic Guardian, fight alongside Duty Units and enhance their skills.

In Unyielding Defense, you'll face tougher enemies and have more Duty Unit skills to unlock. Mix and upgrade skills strategically to maximize your combat power! After clearing Unyielding Defense, you will unlock an extra showdown — Endless Mode! In this mode, the enemy assault never ends. Give it your all and hold out as long as you can!

In Starward Trials, you must apply smart strategies to overcome high-difficulty defense challenges across five different formations.

✧ \[Paradoxical Labyrinth] Limited-Time Event: Battlefield Sigma

Event Period: 10/16 04:00 - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: The limited-time event "Battlefield Sigma" of Paradoxical Labyrinth is available again, introducing the new feature \[Support Sentinel].

You can obtain various buffs through Buff Trials to strengthen your squad for tackling different battlefronts. Challenging different battlefronts earns you Challenge Score based on your combat performance. Accumulate it to unlock various rewards, including DigiCash and event namecard.

✧ \[Paper Dreamland] Fun Gameplay

Event Period: Permanent

Details: Added new pieces and the operative companion feature. Invite a girl to join your match and she'll whisper praise and cheers during the match~

Strategically combine different pieces to maximize Dreamflow Energy. With limited turns, outmatch your opponents by gathering more energy to win unique pieces and Potential Points. Prove your skills in this energy showdown and claim victory! Join the gameplay to earn rewards including exclusive badge, exclusive avatar, exclusive namecard, DigiCash, and Opal Vouchers.

✧ \[Supreme Battleground] Challenge Gameplay

Event Period: 9/25 (After maintenance) - 10/23 04:00 (UTC+8)

The event is divided into 2 cycles with different opening times: "Nexus of Life" and "Nexus of Death." Please check the in-game event page for the exact schedule when it's released.

Details: This Area Challenge features two domains, each with 5 stages. In Stage 5, Adjutants can challenge the boss solo for a limited time, accumulating DMG to reap rewards!

✧ \[Seafoam Anomaly] Challenge Gameplay

Event Period: 10/6 04:00 - 10/20 04:00 (UTC+8)

The event is divided into 2 phases with different opening times. Please check the in-game event page for the exact schedule when it's released.

Details: There are 4 difficulty levels in this period of Trial of Thorns. Consider the range of factors and select the suitable difficulty for your squad. Use effective bonus tactics, execute combo attacks, and master combat skills to efficiently complete special challenges and get higher scores!

✧ \[Hero Games] Co-Op Gameplay

Event Period: 10/23 04:00 - 11/6 04:00 (UTC+8)

Details: During the event, you can exchange 1 Memory Cube by consuming 200 Presence every day. You can initiate 1 Hero Games challenge by using 1 Memory Cube. Challenge powerful enemies with your friends and gain DigiCash, Revision Applications, and other rewards!

notes.content:
The Adjutant arrived at Genoura Manor on a mission to escort Clarina, the heiress of the Genoura family, to Yggdrasil for treatment of her Juvosis. The manor held a banquet in the Adjutant's honor. While the other young girls greeted him with enthusiasm and admiration, Clarina seemed a bit silent. Her aunt Mira later confided that Clarina's resigned attitude stemmed from grim acceptance — her allergy to the Baldr Inhibitor meant treatment was all but impossible. After the Cross-Sea Bridge was destroyed, the Adjutant took Vidya by speedboat across the sea to the main campus of the Academica Acropolis, where they aimed to address the growing crisis in Philossia. It all seemed calm on the surface — but Edda was already moving behind the scenes, ready to risk even the Tree to breach the campus for reasons no one yet understood. Once the sea route was confirmed safe, the Adjutant and Vidya returned to the Frontline Town and regrouped with Katya and Tess, both equipped with upgraded exosuits. notes.content:
In the Hall of Truth, Lizzie was accused of first-degree murder. At the critical moment, the Adjutant, along with Vidya, Fritia, and Eatchel, stepped in as her defense team and took over the investigation. Earlier, the group had arrived at the Frontline Town near Academica Acropolis, where they reunited with Lizzie. She brought them up to speed on the town's current situation and the Philossian Horse project she had been working on with her mentor. During their conversation, Lizzie's plants suddenly withered, and she ran off in a panic. Just as the Adjutant and the girls were about to follow her, a swarm of robots launched a sudden attack.

notes.title: New Update: Abyssal Dawn
notes.content:
After saying goodbye to the squad, the Adjutant and Nita headed to the Charon Sea Base for their mission. A voice lingered in the Adjutant's dream on the way: "Please don't leave me." Upon arrival, they found the base engulfed in severe Titagen contamination, alongside the wreckage of an Academica Acropolis crash. From the traces at the scene, the Adjutant inferred that Nerida might still be alive.

notes.content:
A multitude of intensive research projects had moved forward, working to reveal the secrets of Beiting that Bubu had risked her life for. The Adjutant and his operatives had taken turns entering the Spindle System. While the Adjutant and Yao had achieved consciousness permanence within the system, Chenxing had finished the adaptive training for her new exosuit ahead of schedule. notes.title: New Version: Realm of Illusion
notes.content:
The Adjutant and his operatives arrived via skyskiff at New Hentiro, the City of Miracles in the sky. Agave, the contact assigned by Director τ, led Lyfe to the medical facility where she could receive treatment. The Adjutant and his team learned that the help of the supercomputer called GANGES was required if Lyfe was to be cured. Hence, the Adjutant and Siris decided to head for the Tower of Hanoi. But within the tower, the situation was far from peaceful...

notes.title: New version: Ballad of Chaos!
notes.content:
The Adjutant took the train to Northwind Aerospace Center. As he checked on Eatchel, an illusion appeared before his eyes...
They finally arrived at Duchess Orlova's mansion, where an extravagant masquerade ball was underway. During the ball, the Adjutant spotted a familiar woman. Inside the reception room, the Duchess said that the mansion had been infiltrated. To protect Eatchel, the Adjutant had to resolve the crisis.

1. "Ballad of Chaos" Version Events Launched
Eligibility: Adjutant Lv. 20 or above

✧ Expedited Access to Chapter 12 Pt. 1 in the Main Story: [Ballad of Chaos]
Event Period: 1/18 (After maintenance) – 3/7 04:00 (UTC+8)
Details: Experience an all-new Chapter 12 Pt. 1 in the main story. Enter the Orlov Mansion to reveal the truth hiding behind the mask.
Adjutants at the required Adjutant Level or above at any point during the event period can directly access Chapter 12 Pt. 1 (no need to unlock the preceding 11 chapters of the Main Story).

✧ [Paradoxical Labyrinth] Challenge Gameplay
Event Period: Permanent from 1/18 (After maintenance)
Details: Paradoxical Labyrinth is a combat simulation system developed by the R&D Department.
The system automatically generates different routes after integrating previous combat data and uncovering the characteristics of different battle scenarios. Adjutants can leverage the system to experience a variety of simulated battles randomly constructed, challenges and opportunities hidden behind the door, and develop your best tactical strategy.

The Purple-tier pistol "Wild Wasp Stinger" and Akitsu Squad logistics officers will be available for exchange in the Unlimited shop from 2/7 10:00 to 3/7 04:00 (UTC+8).
Note: Snowshade Ring-Pulls and Starlight Emblems can be obtained from event gameplay and tasks.
